summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/worker-6 re-adjudication resolved the open framework-test ticket by reconciling Table 1, Figure 1, supplementary Figure S1, and linked database rows. The paper is accepted with cautions because rounded hemolysis values and unsupported anticancer database labels are preserved as conflicts, not promoted to clean evidence.
adjudication_summary: Ds-defensin has primary-source support for the mature peptide sequence, antimicrobial Table 1 values, low hemolysis values from supplementary Figure S1A, and qualitative no-cytotoxic-effect evidence from Figure S1B. No direct mechanism assay is present; the final mechanism layer is bounded to contextual evidence.

materials_exhausted.note: Local source materials are exhausted for the worker-4/worker-6 blockers. Remaining gaps are nonblocking exact plot/table-absence cautions recorded in unrecoverable_material_gaps.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 35 linked database audit rows were rechecked. Source-supported MIC/no-effect/cytotoxicity rows now have primary locators; rounded hemolysis and unsupported anticancer/mammalian labels remain source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity/toxicity now includes 16 source-supported rows: Table 1 MIC/no-effect rows, supplementary Figure S1A hemolysis values, and Figure S1B qualitative cell-viability claims. Exact RLU values were not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism was downgraded from the previous automated nucleic-acid note to a bounded no-direct-mechanism adjudication; phenotype and defensin-family context are retained without overclaim.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary supplementary Figure S1A exact labels differ from rounded DBAASP hemolysis values; rows are preserved as source_conflict.
CAMP/dbAMP anticancer/mammalian activity labels are not supported by local primary material; Figure S1B supports no cytotoxic effect at 10 µM.
The paper reports defensin identity, expression, and antimicrobial phenotypes but not a direct killing mechanism assay.
Figure S1B supports qualitative no-cytotoxic-effect claims but not exact RLU extraction.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact RLU values are not fabricated. This does not block publication-grade curation because the database rows under review encode qualitative not-active/no-cytotoxic-effect claims rather than exact RLU measurements.
